_comment: Copy to deploy.config.json and edit if needed. ALL keys are optional — sensible defaults are derived from your AWS identity. Region is FIXED to ap-south-1 (data residency) and cannot be changed here.
_comment_account_id: Optional. Your 12-digit AWS account id. If omitted, it is resolved from your AWS credentials (STS).
_comment_data_bucket: Optional. S3 bucket (in ap-south-1) for the demo CSVs. If omitted, defaults to residency-chatbot-data-<account_id> and is created for you.
_comment_data_prefix: Optional. Key prefix inside the bucket for the demo CSVs. Default: chatbot-load.
_comment_model_id: REQUIRED. Bedrock ON_DEMAND bare modelId with Converse tool-use support, invocable in-region. This solution is model-agnostic: pick any model from the Bedrock regional model availability page (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/models-region-compatibility.html) — availability changes over time. Cross-region inference profiles (us.*/eu.*/ap.*/apac.*/jp.*/au.*/global.*) are blocked by the residency guard.
